messages.author: 39e37739a45d1c94
messages.subject: set the jvm heap size
parts:
Seems when I run large dataset,  the jvm always crash because the heap size is too small.

I am wondering is there a way that I can set the Xms and Xmx for the hadoop-streaming's jvm?

Thanks,

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#945] set the jvm heap size
parts:
I don't think you are on the right track but just do a help(mapreduce) and look at the backend.parameters argument. Whatever you can pass to streaming you can pass there. Deprecated feature, use at your own risk.


Antoni
